_note: Scripted normal use for the Q4 baseline (D13 points 1-3, D24 point 4), fixed before any baseline session. One cycle = open the client in the trusted test folder ~/q3-repo, run the four tasks in this order, close the client. Cycles repeat until the session's minutes are over. {k} is the cycle number. The q3-lab server keeps definition A for the whole session (no change, no notification): calling it is normal use of a known, approved server. Each task has the evidence that it really happened (D24 point 4): answered = the client is back at its ready screen after answering; test-run = the test file wrote its run time to .q4-test-runs after the prompt; file-contains = the edited file holds the requested line; server-call = the lab server logged a new tool call for this session. A refused or failed action therefore does not count as done.

setup_files.test_greet.py:
import time, unittest
from pathlib import Path

from greet import greet

# lab instrumentation: every run of the tests leaves its time here, the evidence that the test task really ran
with open(Path(__file__).resolve().parent / ".q4-test-runs", "a") as _f:
    _f.write(f"{time.time()}\n")


class Greet(unittest.TestCase):
    def test_greet(self):
        self.assertEqual(greet("lab"), "hello, lab")


if __name__ == "__main__":
    unittest.main()
